reviews.name: Kathy K.
reviews.text: Ivan responded promptly, showed up on time, and diagnosed the problem quickly. He ordered the part and replaced it the day it came in. The repair was done expertly and very neatly.

reviews.name: Karen H.
reviews.text: Scheduled same day, texted 10 minutes out, arrived on time, repaired my oven in an hour. My oven is a Dacor and it's hard to find repair shops willing to work on them.

reviews.name: Reid L.
reviews.text: Even though we're a bit of a drive for him, he came out that day after I called. Fixed our overflowing dishwasher problem that day. Very professional.
